items.text: Since the Act was gazetted on 20 February 2026, adults may possess up to 56 g of cannabis or 15 g of resin without criminal liability (s 6(5), Eighth Schedule).

Smoking or using cannabis in, or within 5 m of the entrance, exit, window or air intake of, a public place, workplace or public transport: XCD 300 fixed penalty, or up to XCD 5,000 on summary conviction (s 13B).
Using cannabis on or near school premises: up to XCD 250,000 and 7 years summarily (s 13C). Home growing needs prior registration with the Cannabis Secretariat.
